steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__game; const gl=g.renderer.getContext(); let calls=0, tris=0; for(const fn of ['drawElements','drawArrays','drawElementsInstanced','drawArraysInstanced']){ const o=gl[fn].bind(gl); gl[fn]=(...a)=>{ calls++; const n=fn.startsWith('drawElements')?a[1]:a[2]; const inst=fn.endsWith('Instanced')?a[a.length-1]:1; tris+=n/3*inst; return o(...a);}; } const out=[]; for(const id of ['E2','E6']){ g.loadRound(id); g.showScreen(null); g.mode='play'; g.player.release(); const x=g.course.finishX*0.4; let d=g.course.supportAt(x,0), xx=x; while(!d){xx-=0.5; d=g.course.supportAt(xx,0);} g.player.respawn({x:xx,y:d.topAt(xx)}); g.cam.snap(g.player,g.course); g.renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate=true; g.render(1/60); calls=0; tris=0; g.renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate=true; g.render(1/60); out.push(id+': '+calls+' draw calls, '+(tris/1000).toFixed(0)+'k triangles per frame'); } return out})()
